title: GAP Waiver Level Absorption Shares — Trade-In Agreements
content:
Under **Trade-In Agreements**, the GAP absorption share of a roll-in depends on the **Kestrel GAP Waiver** attached to the Kestrel Auto Finance contract of the purchase the trade is applied to.

| GAP waiver attached to the finance contract | GAP absorption share |
|---|---|
| None | 0.9 |
| Kestrel GAP Essential | 0.95 |
| Kestrel GAP Standard | 0.95 |
| Any higher GAP waiver level | One (no reduction) |

The share multiplies the negative equity rolled in. It acts once on that amount, before the amount is held to no more than the finance tier's maximum negative equity and before the rounding to the nearest cent.

## Reading the schedule

- A finance contract with no GAP waiver attached takes the no-GAP share of 0.9.
- The two entry levels, Kestrel GAP Essential and Kestrel GAP Standard, take the basic-GAP share of 0.95.
- Every level above Kestrel GAP Standard takes no reduction.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Negative equity of $2200.00 on a trade whose linked finance contract carries no GAP waiver: $2200.00 multiplied by 0.9 is $1980.00. With a Kestrel GAP Standard waiver attached it would be $2090.00.
